mcq_fix.s: Consider the following pairs (Dynasty — Founder): 1. Tughlaq — Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq 2. Sayyid — Khizr Khan 3. Lodi — Bahlol Lodi 4. Mamluk — Iltutmish  Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
mcq_fix.why: stem did not say pairs are founders; Iltutmish is a Mamluk ruler, so pair 4 was arguably correct

mcq_drop.why: ambiguous: both Kaiqubad and Kayumars are given as last Slave ruler in standard sources, both are options

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: Timur invaded (1398) under Nasiruddin Mahmud Tughlaq; Bahlul Lodi (key 2) is wrong and no option is correct
wrong topic: Vijayanagara culture / dance forms

patterns: APPSC asks direct 'which Sultan' items: conquest of South completed under MBT; Ministry of Agriculture (Diwan-i-Kohi) = MBT; plus a match of Sultan vs reign years (Jalaluddin 1290-96, MBT 1324/25-51, Khizr Khan 1414-21, Bahlol 1451-89).

Other PSCs recycle the same facts: token currency, Agra founded by Sikandar Lodi, Ashokan pillars/canals/employment bureau/translation dept = Firoz, market control = Alauddin, longest dynasty Tughlaq, shortest Khalji, Bahlol longest reign.
Traps: Timur under the last Tughlaq (not MBT/Firoz), Mongols at Indus under Iltutmish, two Nasiruddin Mahmuds, Lakh Baksh = Aibak, Zil-i-Ilahi = Balban.
App MCQs mostly match PYQ depth; it adds AP angle (Kakatiya annexation 1323) and current-affairs (Rajon ki Baoli) and uses more statement-type items than the PYQs.
Reign-year matching is the main APPSC format here; app should keep Jalaluddin and Khizr Khan reign dates handy.
